faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: How AniKitty works, what needs an account, and what data the site collects.
faq.noSearchResults: No FAQ answers match that search.
faq.contactDesc: Join the Discord community or open an issue on GitHub. For account-specific requests (deletion, privacy), contact moderators there.

basics.whatIsA: AniKitty is a free, ad-free anime streaming site with no subscription paywall. Browse the catalog, watch episodes in sub or dub where available, rate and review titles, and join community features when signed in. Optional Ko-fi tips unlock the donator rank and badge. AniKitty does not host video files — streams are resolved through third-party sources via KittyAPI.
basics.accountA: No — you can browse and watch without signing in. An account unlocks your watchlist, synced progress across devices, watch history, episode comments, forum posts, live chat, friends, public profiles, levels and achievements, Kittycoins, optional AniList import, reviews, and security options like 2FA and passkeys. Sign up from the Log in button in the navbar.
basics.freeA: Yes. There is no paid subscription and no ads. Watching stays free for everyone. Tip €4 on Ko-fi with your @username to unlock about 30 days of donator rank (plus the donator badge). Tips are optional.

watching.streamingA: When you open an episode, AniKitty asks KittyAPI for a stream using the anime's AniList ID, episode number, and your audio mode (Sub, Hard Subs, or Dub). Sources appear as site codenames only — never the real host names. Default order starts with HQ, then Juliet, Gamma, Whiskey, Guard, Bravo, Xray, Echo, and the rest. Use the compact picker or the full Sub / Hard Subs / Dub grid (Settings → Playback → Simple source picker). Turn on auto-fallback in player settings to try the next source when playback fails. Progress saves to your account when logged in.
watching.providersA: AniKitty does not host video — streams come through KittyAPI from third-party providers, shown only by site labels (HQ, Juliet, Gamma, Whiskey, Guard, Bravo, Xray, Echo, GG, Yen, Kilo, Alpha, Sierra, Uniform, Hotel, and Haven when adult titles are enabled). Some sources offer soft subtitle tracks; others are hard-sub only. Hotel is Japanese audio only. New watches use your Settings default source and fallback order; you can switch anytime while watching.
watching.subDubQ: How do sub, hard subs, and dub work?
watching.subDubA: The watch page splits sources into Sub, Hard Subs, and Dub. Sub prefers soft-subtitle lines; Hard Subs lists burn-in / hard-only sources; Dub loads English audio where the source supports it. Hotel has no dub. If you pick Dub but that episode has no dub file, AniKitty can fall back to Sub on the same source. Use player settings to auto-enable soft subtitles or overlay soft subs on hard-sub streams if needed.
watching.playerSettingsQ: What can I change in player settings?
watching.playerSettingsA: Open the gear icon in the player for Playback, Captions, Quality, Speed, and Display. Tune auto-next, auto-skip, seek step, touch seek, Lite mode, Anime4K (WebGPU), theatre/lights, and source layout. Stream nodes pick themselves by ping with failover — you only choose the source. On phones the settings sheet stays compact so it does not cover the whole video.
watching.castQ: Can I cast to my TV?
watching.castA: Yes. Chromecast (Cast button) works on supported browsers and remints a TV-friendly stream URL. AirPlay (Safari / iOS / macOS) uses the AirPlay button — AniKitty switches to a native stream before connecting so Apple TV is not stuck on a black screen. Casting needs a public HTTPS site; localhost and private URLs cannot reach the TV.
watching.continueA: When signed in, the home page and your profile show titles you started recently so you can jump back in. Progress is stored in the database and cached locally in your browser for faster resume. You can also open the full Watch History page from the account menu.
watching.recommendationsA: When signed in with some watch history, the home page shows a "Recommended for you" row based on related titles from the catalog. New accounts see a prompt to start watching first.
watching.recentlyViewedQ: What is the Recently viewed row?
watching.recentlyViewedA: The home page keeps a local list of anime you opened recently so you can jump back to something you were browsing. It is stored only in your browser and is separate from Continue Watching.
watching.voiceActorsQ: Can I look up voice actors?
watching.voiceActorsA: Yes. Open any anime and use the Voice Actors tab, or click a voice actor to open their page with their full filmography. You can also search voice actors by name and filter by language from the Voice Actors page in the footer.
watching.anilistQ: Can I sync my list from AniList?
watching.anilistA: Yes. In Settings → Connections, connect AniList via OAuth and import your library into your AniKitty watchlist. MyAnimeList account sign-in was removed — use AniList for list sync. Anime pages still show MyAnimeList metadata (score, rank, popularity, etc.) for reference.
watching.subtitlesA: In Sub mode, the player loads soft subtitle tracks when the source includes them. Hard-sub streams already have text burned in — enable soft subs on hard-sub streams in player settings only if you want extra tracks on top. Customize appearance and timing in Captions / Settings. The Subtitle Library lists tracks cached when you watch episodes — use refresh on that page to fetch more.
watching.scheduleA: Schedule shows what is airing this week in your local timezone. Trending highlights popular and upcoming titles from the catalog feed.
watching.liteModeA: Lite mode in Settings reduces animations, panel blur, and extra effects so the site feels lighter on low-power devices. It also keeps Anime4K off and skips some background work while you watch.

accountSection.createQ: How do I create an account?
accountSection.createA: Click Log in in the navbar, switch to Sign up, and enter a username (3–25 letters, numbers, or underscores), email, and password (8+ characters). Your password is hashed before storage. After signing in you can add a passkey under Settings → Security for faster sign-in with Face ID, Touch ID, or Windows Hello.
accountSection.profileQ: What is on my public profile?
accountSection.profileA: Others can see your avatar, banner, bio, role and level badges, achievements, watchlist lists, watch-activity heatmap, and recent episode comments — unless you turn on Ninja mode in Settings → Privacy. Your profile also shows follower counts, a library breakdown, and friend actions when viewing someone else.
accountSection.ninjaA: Ninja mode hides your profile, watchlist, activity, and comments from everyone except you. Your username can still appear in live chat, forum posts, and episode comments.
accountSection.levelsQ: How do levels and XP work?
accountSection.levelsA: XP comes from watching episodes and posting episode comments. Levels unlock display tiers on your profile, chat, and forum. Daily login streaks grant bonus Kittycoins every 7 days.
accountSection.achievementsA: Achievements are badges you unlock for milestones like episodes watched, comments posted, reviews written, leveling up, and login streaks. They appear on your profile sidebar with progress bars for locked ones.
accountSection.passkeysA: Optional passkeys let you sign in with Face ID, Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key instead of typing your password. Add or remove them under Settings → Security. Passkeys are stored on your device (or synced by your password manager when supported).
accountSection.twoFactorA: Optional TOTP can be enabled under Settings → Security. When enabled, login requires your password plus a 6-digit code from an authenticator app.
accountSection.sessionsA: Settings → Security lists devices where you are logged in. You can revoke individual sessions or log out everywhere.

community.chatA: Live chat is real-time and requires an account. Messages auto-delete after a short time. You can edit or delete your own messages, search GIFs inline, and links in messages are clickable.
community.forumA: The forum is for longer discussions — threads, replies, polls, and staff announcements. Content is stored until moderators remove it.
community.commentsA: On the watch page you can leave text and optional GIF comments per episode or for the whole anime when signed in. Comments support @mentions, clickable timestamps that jump the player, and ||inline spoilers||. Use ··· on a comment to copy its link or report it. Moderators can pin a comment. Sort by New, Best, Top, or Old. On phones, open Comments from the preview card under the player.
community.followA: Yes. Open someone's profile and tap Follow. You get a notification when someone follows you, and each profile shows follower and following counts you can tap to see the full lists.
community.friendsA: Following is one-way — you see their public activity. Friends are mutual: send a request from their profile, accept or decline incoming requests, and unfriend anytime. Both users get notified when you become friends.
community.notificationsA: The bell in the navbar shows unread mentions, replies, new followers, friend requests, and direct messages. Mark everything read from the dropdown, and choose which types you receive in Settings → Notifications.
community.blockA: Yes. Use the Block button on a user's profile. Blocking hides their comments from you and stops them from messaging or following you. Manage your blocked list in Settings → Privacy.
community.reportQ: How do I report a comment?
community.reportA: Open ··· on any comment and choose Report to send it to moderators. Reports go into a moderation queue where staff can resolve or dismiss them.
community.w2gA: Open a room from any episode with Watch Together — it appears on the Watch Together page for anyone to join. Hosts can delete their room when done; guests leave without closing it. Playback stays synced and you can chat in the room panel.
community.onlineQ: What does the online counter mean?
community.onlineA: The online badge counts unique browsers currently on the site — guests and signed-in users — based on a short heartbeat from every page. It is not a list of usernames.

privacy.dataQ: What data does AniKitty store about me?
privacy.dataA: Account info (username, email, password hash, profile customization), watch data (watchlist, progress, history), community content (chat, forum, comments, messages), social graph (follows, friends, blocks), session records, achievements, Kittycoin balance, and preferences like Ninja mode.
privacy.browserQ: What is stored only in my browser?
privacy.browserA: Session cookie, player and UI settings (including Lite mode), progress cache, recently viewed anime, online heartbeat ID, level stats cache, and subtitle appearance preferences.
privacy.thirdPartyA: Google Analytics for page views, KittyAPI for streams, AniList if you connect it, optional Anisurge if you link an account, and external Discord/GitHub/Ko-fi/Telegram links.
privacy.notDoA: AniKitty does not sell your personal data, does not show ads, and does not host video files on its servers.
privacy.deleteQ: How can I delete my data?
privacy.deleteA: Go to Settings → Privacy → Account deletion to request permanent removal. You can also revoke sessions, disconnect AniList, and manage blocked users before deleting.
privacy.cookiesA: Sign-in uses an HttpOnly session cookie. Stream playback uses a short-lived playback session cookie for the HLS proxy. Google Analytics may set its own cookies. The site enforces HTTPS in production.

support.kofiA: No. The site is free whether you donate or not. Tips are optional — they grant the donator rank and badge while active, and they help cover costs.
support.donatorA: Every €4 with your @username in the Ko-fi message = about 30 days of donator rank (badge on your profile and comments). €8 ≈ 60 days, and so on. Watching stays free and ad-free for everyone either way.

security.passwordA: Passwords are hashed with bcrypt. Login issues a signed JWT in an HttpOnly session cookie. Passkeys use the WebAuthn standard and never send your biometric data to our servers.
security.httpsA: Yes — use the site over HTTPS. HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS in production.
security.rateLimitA: Sensitive actions (sign-up, login, posting, reporting) are rate-limited by IP and/or user ID to reduce abuse.
security.moderationA: Admins and moderators can manage forum content, live chat, comment reports, and user roles. Staff announcements appear in the forum.

rules.title: Comment community rules
rules.intro: Before you post, please read and follow these rules. They keep discussions fun and safe for everyone.
rules.agreeLabel: I have read and agree to follow these community rules.

items.spoilers: Mark spoilers with the Spoiler button. Don't reveal plot twists, endings, or future events without tagging them.
items.respect: Be respectful. Harassment, hate speech, slurs, and personal attacks are not allowed.
items.nsfw: No NSFW content — sexual, overly graphic, or inappropriate material is not allowed in comments or GIFs.
items.spam: No spam, ads, scam links, or off-topic flooding. Keep comments about the anime and episode.
items.moderation: Moderators may remove comments or restrict accounts that break these rules.

donate.title: Support AniKitty
donate.subtitle: Optional tips keep the lights on. €4 on Ko-fi with your @username = 1 month donator rank.
donate.body: AniKitty stays free and ad-free for everyone. Tip €4 (or any amount) on Ko-fi with your @username to unlock 1 month of donator rank per €4.
donate.badgePreviewDesc: €4 ≈ 30 days of donator rank — badge on your profile and comments.
donate.donationDesc: Include your AniKitty @username in the Ko-fi message. €4 → 30 days donator, €8 → 60 days, €2 → 15 days. Stacks if you tip again before it expires.
donate.claimSignIn: Sign in to activate your donator rank.
donate.claimSuccess: Donator unlocked for {days} days — thank you for supporting AniKitty!
donate.claimNotFound: No matching Ko-fi tip found yet. Include your @username in the Ko-fi message, wait a minute, then try again or DM @fampep.
donate.claimFeedUnavailable: Auto-activation is temporarily unavailable — DM @fampep and we will help manually.
donate.claimAmountTooSmall: That tip is too small to activate donator rank.
donate.claimFailed: Could not activate donator. Try again or DM @fampep.

steps.pay: Tip on Ko-fi (€4 = 1 month). Put {username} in the Ko-fi message field.
steps.dm: Send @{username} a DM containing {mention} — or tap Activate donator on this page.
steps.auto: We match recent Ko-fi tips and grant donator days from the amount (€4 → 30 days).
steps.help: Something wrong? DM @{username} and we will sort it out manually.

donate.activeDonator: Your tip is active — you have the donator rank. Thank you!
donate.faqDonatorA: Every €4 with your @username in the Ko-fi message = about 30 days of donator rank (badge on your profile and comments). €8 ≈ 60 days, and so on. The site stays free and ad-free either way.
donate.faqKoFiA: Tip on Ko-fi (ko-fi.com/fampep) with your @username in the message, then tap Activate donator on this page or DM @fampep. We match recent tips automatically when possible.
donate.faqVoluntaryA: No. Watching stays free. Tips are optional — €4 unlocks 1 month of donator rank if you want it.
